The visualizer tool streams a self-contained HTML document into the chat "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"as the model writes it, with a live preview in a sandboxed inline frame — Chart.js, external CDN lib"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"raries, all of it. Nothing touches the workspace."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-visualizer"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin. The **`visualizer`** tool streams a self-contained HTML document into the"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" chat as the model writes it, with a live preview in a sandboxed inline frame — Chart.js, external C"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"DN libraries, all of it. Nothing touches the workspace."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"One package ships both halves: the model-facing tool (`lib/index.js`) and the Web GUI card (`lib/cli"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ent.js`, declared through the package's `dsh.client` manifest). Install it and a bundle layer mounts"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" both. No manual profile patch editing."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Every generation is downloadable from the card as a self-contained `.html` (or `.svg`) file. No serv"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"on is downloadable from the card as a self-contained `.html` (or `.svg`) file. No server round-trip."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Settled cards also carry a **comment mode**: toggle the pen control in the row chrome, click any ele"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ment (or drag a rectangle) inside the frame, and each pick becomes a comment row below the renderer "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"showing the element's selector, markup, and text. Write a note per pick and Send — the picks compose"},{"id":"p6s4","text":" one `[widget]` turn for the model, locator bundle included, so it can edit the exact elements you p"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ointed at. Esc or the toggle exits; the document runs pristine while mode is off."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Full-length demos, one per artifact type:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"1. Pull request flow overview — diagram
2. Photosynthesis explainer — interactive
3. How computers w"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ork — mockup (shown above)
4. The plugin itself, explained and rendered by the plugin — self-hosted
"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"5. Streaming generative UI highlights — highlights
6. Combined demo — multiple use cases in one run"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Requires Node ^22.19 or >=24 and a DeepSeek Harness installation on `0.1.2-rc.1` or newer (older bui"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"lds: see Harness version below):"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The first run fails with an "Add the package to allowBuilds" hint. That's pnpm's supply-chain gate b"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"locking the `prepare` build until it's allowlisted; the hint carries the exact key, keyed on the cod"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"eload URL and the resolved commit. Paste that block under `allowBuilds:` in `~/.dsh/profiles/<your-p"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"rofile>/pnpm-workspace.yaml` and re-run. Keys pin the commit, so after a new upstream push, reinstal"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"ling prints a fresh hint to paste."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Harness version"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The default branch tracks the **latest DeepSeek Harness pre-release** (`0.1.2-rc.1` or newer). `0.1."},{"id":"p14s2","text":"2-alpha.3` renamed the client `conversationEvents` service to `uiConversation` and moved the Chat No"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"de out of `dsh-client-ui-conversation` into the new `dsh-client-ui-chat` package, so the card cannot"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" mount on builds older than that — the tool parks at `pending (waiting for service: conversationEven"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"ts)`. `0.1.2-rc.1`'s Compact transcript view can fold a settled card away once its turn closes; see "},{"id":"p14s6","text":"Settled cards and Compact transcript view below for how this plugin handles that."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"On an older harness (`0.1.1-rc.2` and earlier pre-alpha builds), install the pre-alpha compatibility"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" branch instead, with a ref fragment:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"That branch is the last state of the plugin built against the pre-`0.1.2-alpha.3` client API. It is "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"frozen — new features land on the default branch only — so upgrading the harness is the way forward."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Settled cards and Compact transcript view"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Compact transcript view folds a settled card's tool-call row away once its turn closes. This plugin "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"keeps the card live in place until then, and republishes it through the harness's `turn-tail` extens"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ion point once the turn closes — the only way to survive the fold, since that hole doesn't exist any"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" earlier. Normal view never folds, so the card just stays where it always was, with no second copy. "},{"id":"p19s5","text":"See `CHANGELOG.md` for the mechanics."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Or Install from a local checkout"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"To hack on the plugin (or install a version not yet pushed), check it out, build, and add it by loca"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" on the plugin (or install a version not yet pushed), check it out, build, and add it by local path:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"A local path skips the git fetch and the `allowBuilds` dance, since `pnpm build` already produced `l"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ib/`. The loader still imports from the installed copy under the profile, though. To pick up changes"},{"id":"p23s3","text":": re-run `pnpm build` in the checkout, then `remove` and `add` again."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Boot the profile and ask the model to **"visualize …"**; the streamed document appears inline while "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"it's written. Pin a release with a ref fragment (`'git+https://github.com/abidhmuhsin/dsh-visualizer"},{"id":"p24s3","text":".git#v0.2.0'`). To remove:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The tool declares `html` as its last schema parameter, so logged call arguments carry a growing docu"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ment prefix while the model streams. The card paints that prefix live inside a null-origin sandboxed"},{"id":"p27s3","text":" iframe; at dispatch the final DOM reconciles and scripts run once. An authoring guide teaches the m"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"odel when to reach for each artifact type (`chart`, `diagram`, `mockup`, `interactive`, `art`) and h"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"ow to author it — a one-line roster in the system prompt, with deeper per-type recipes on demand thr"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"ough a `visualizer_guide` tool so the standing prompt stays small. A settle-time static check inspec"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"ts the finished document (compiled, never executed) and reports defects back to the model for an in-"},{"id":"p27s8","text":"nished document (compiled, never executed) and reports defects back to the model for an in-turn fix."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Rendered documents can talk back through a small bridge: scripts may submit a follow-up chat prompt "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"(`sendPrompt`, validated and rate-limited), open http(s) links (`openLink`, scheme-checked), and per"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"sist state across renders (`window.storage`, namespaced by title — a regenerated dashboard finds its"},{"id":"p28s4","text":" previous values). Documents inherit the app's theme tokens, and anchor clicks inside the card never"},{"id":"p28s5","text":" navigate the app: fragments scroll in place, external links pass the same validation gate. A card s"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"hows load/runtime script failures inline instead of silently rendering nothing. `window.share` (`{ex"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"ported, url}`, plus a `dsh-share-status` window event) tells a document its own current share state "},{"id":"p28s8","text":"— read-only; a document can observe whether it has been shared but never trigger a share itself, sin"},{"id":"p28s9","text":"ce that stays a deliberate, one-click chrome action."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
